title: A Burst Pipe Usually Shows Up as a Wet Floor | Smart Home Fixes #4

beats.text: First freeze is coming. A burst pipe usually announces itself with a wet floor.
Leak sensors go under the water heater, under the sink, and behind the washer.
Water touches one, your phone gets an alert. Many also warn you when it's freezing.
Upgrade: an automatic shut-off closes the main water valve for you.
Which spot would you check first?
